subject: general
question: How many scientists received the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Award (SSB) for Science and Technology, 2021, on the occasion of the 80th Foundation Day of the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 11.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) declare Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Award 2021 for Science & Technology. 
 
• This trophy has been given to 11 scientists from all over the country for their notable donations to science and technology.
 
• Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar (SSB) trophy has been named following the maker & Director of CSIR, late Dr Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar.
 
• The names of the receivers are traditionally announced by the Director General on every 26 September, which is the CSIR Foundation Day.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The prize is divided into seven regulations, namely:**
 
• **Biological science**

 
• Chemical Sciences
 
• Earth, Atmosphere, Ocean and Planetary Sciences
 
• Engineering Sciences
 
• Mathematical Sciences
 
• Medical Sciences
 
• Physical Sciences. 
 
• Each discipline can have many winners. 
 
• Up until 2007, the prize money was ₹2 lakh (US$2,500) and was increased to ₹5 lakh (US$6,300) in 2008.
